items.title: The -250 floor and the over-70% requirement can only overlap between 70.0% and 71.4%
items.detail: -250 is an implied probability of 71.43%, so any selection the model rates above 71.43% prices shorter than the floor. This desk grades 120 of its 435 picks High; 20 of those sit inside -250 to +10,000 and carry a written prediction, while 100 are shorter than -250. Both sets are published with their prices and neither is relabelled. No price was bent to fit the window.

items.title: Lines were originated for 3 of the 19 sport labels considered; the other 16 are blank and reasoned
items.detail: Only NHL, MLB and LoL Esports had official numeric inputs in reach this session, so only those carry prices. 10 further labels appear as OLBG listing rows with the official source left blank, and 6 had no in-window fixture on any official page captured here. Nothing is estimated to fill the gap.

items.title: World Series prices use season-long run rates, with no starting pitcher, bullpen or park adjustment
items.detail: The MLB payload used here returns team runs scored and allowed over 162 games plus home/away splits, and nothing about probable starters, bullpen usage or park factors. The seven World Series games are therefore priced from team-level run rates only, which is a real limitation in a short series. No pitcher data is invented and the gap is recorded rather than filled.

items.title: A regulation draw is split 50/50 in the NHL model because no shootout model is defensible from the payload
items.detail: The two-way NHL price has to do something with a tied score after regulation. This desk gives each side half of the draw probability, which leaves the moneyline slightly conservative for strong teams. The assumption is named in model_spec.json and is not presented as an observed value.

items.title: LoL map handicaps and map totals assume independent, identical maps
items.detail: The LoL schedule payload gives series records and best-of length but no map-level scores, so the map markets are derived from a per-map probability under an independent-maps assumption. That flattens real draft and side effects. 25 listed series carry no price at all because the payload returns no record for at least one team.

items.title: Window published as 2026-10-22 to 2026-11-09, not the full 22 October to 21 November range
items.detail: The captured daily payloads run to 2 November and the last fixture they contain falls on 2026-11-09. No official page was read for 10-21 November, so that part of the requested window is empty rather than guessed. A fresh capture of those dates would extend the desk.

items.title: OLBG's listing is carried as a listing, never as an official source
items.detail: 119 in-scope match rows are reproduced with their event name, start time and OLBG link so the in-scope universe is visible. Each of them has a blank official source, a blank price and a blank pick, and none of OLBG's tips, percentages, prices or comments is copied. Only rows with a governing-body payload behind them are marked verified.

items.title: NHL strength inputs come from one standings snapshot and are not re-read per match date
items.detail: Every NHL price uses the 2026-10-22 standings snapshot, so fixtures in November are priced with October form. The snapshot is hash-checked and its capture time is printed on every row; it is not silently blended with later results.

items.title: No injury, suspension, line-up, weather or line-movement check was performed
items.detail: The register covers participants, date, start time, venue and the numeric scoring inputs only. Team news and market movement are named as unchecked on every row rather than implied to be clear.

items.title: Two High picks land on the same Islanders-Wild fixture and are correlated
items.detail: The Islanders +1.5 puck line and the under 6.5 goals both qualify on 30 October in Minnesota. A tight, low-scoring game settles both, so they should be treated as one view, not two independent bets. Both are published with separate write-ups and the correlation is disclosed here.

items.title: Recent-results evidence is limited to the games present in the captured 15-21 October payloads
items.detail: Those daily files list only the games the NHL feed returned for each date, so a few clubs show two completed games rather than three. Write-ups cite only games present in the payloads; no result is inferred from a standings total.

items.title: Two captured AFL payloads are gzip bytes stored with a .json extension
items.detail: data/session-e5f2dad3/raw/afl_api_fixtures.json and afl_api_season.json begin with the gzip magic bytes rather than JSON, and the capture manifest records both as HTTP 401. Any tool that globs data/**/*.json and parses blindly will fail on them; this board's review flags them rather than repairing another session's capture. They are not used as inputs here.

items.title: Three generators target the repository root, and running two of them deletes this board's pointer
items.detail: scripts/session-83451f65/build_site.py and tools/build_master_site.py both write index.html at the repository root, while scripts/session-74f9613e/build_site.py writes only its own directory. Running either root generator while preparing this board replaced the committed dashboard, removed this board's nav link and callout, and produced a 35-line diff; the committed file was restored from HEAD and the pointer re-applied. No CI gate diffs the root against either generator, so the same thing can happen to any board's pointer without a failing check. This is recorded, not fixed, because both generators belong to other scopes.

items.title: Sixteen archived pages under session-4a73430b/ are missing closing html tags
items.detail: The review's well-formedness check fails on every page in session-4a73430b/ (index, picks, markets, olbg, methodology, flagged and ten sport pages): each file ends without </body> or </html>. Browsers render them and the local link audit passes, so nothing published is broken, but the markup is truncated and any strict parser will reject it. The files belong to another board's scope, so they are reported here and left untouched.

items.title: One archived board page is missing its closing html tag
items.detail: session-07a080b9/index.html ends after its last paragraph with no </body> or </html>, so the file is truncated markup rather than a complete document. Browsers render it and the local link audit passes, but it is not well-formed HTML. The file belongs to another board's scope, so it is reported here and left untouched.

items.title: Two existing generators rewrite the repository root, so a root pointer can be overwritten silently
items.detail: tools/build_master_site.py and scripts/session-83451f65/build_site.py both write index.html and the root pages. No CI gate diffs the root against either generator. This board kept its root change additive and restored the committed pages after testing, and the collision is recorded here rather than fixed inside another board's generator.
